name: Pereira / Coffee Axis, Colombia

rent.notes: 2026 guide puts furnished 2-3BR in Pinares/Cerritos at COP 3.5-6.0M (USD 1,120-1,920) and a couple's estrato 5-6 sample at COP 4.2M; older IL data and a 2026 retirement guide show 3BR/furnished units from USD 300-750. Typical set for an unfurnished pet-friendly 2-3BR incl. COP 250-600k admin fee, below furnished expat pricing. Converted at TRM 3,183.

groceries.notes: Couple mixing plaza and supermarkets COP 0.9-1.6M/mo, sample COP 1.2M (2026 guide). Source covers people only; food for a 100 lb dog is not separately verified and may add to this.

utilities.notes: Electricity, water/sewer, gas plus 200-300 Mbps fiber run COP 350-650k for estrato 4-5 (couple sample COP 580k); fiber (~COP 100-140k) removed since internet is excluded. Mild climate, no AC needed.

healthcare.notes: EPS (mandatory for cedula holders) at 12.5% of declared income, min 1 SMMLV (COP 219k) and typically ~3 SMMLV (COP 657k) for one cotizante with spouse as beneficiary, plus prepagada for two at age 60 (~COP 700k each interpolated between age-50 ~470k and age-65 ~800k, less 10% family discount). Min uses basic Colmedica-level prepagada; max approaches top-tier or international cover. Now carries the full health-coverage cost (old template split it into insurance).

transportation.notes: Transit/taxi model: Megabus COP 3,600/ride, taxi min ~COP 7,300, couple sample COP 400k/mo. Regular gasoline COP 16,322/gal in Pereira (Oct 2026) if a car is used; car insurance/SOAT not verified, so max may be low for car ownership.
